# 2 Baruch Chapter 72 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**72:1** "And-now-hear concerning-the-bright-lightning which-came-at-the-end, and-after-the-black-waters."

**72:2** "This-is the-word. After-all-the-signs-of-which-I-have-spoken-to-you shall-have-come, when-the-nations-are-troubled, and-the-time-of-my-Messiah-has-come,"

**72:3** "he-will-summon all-the-nations, and-some-of-them he-will-spare, and-some-of-them he-will-slay."

**72:4** "These-are-the-things-that-will-befall-the-nations that-have-not-known-my-people: every-nation-that-has-not-known-Israel, and-that-has-not-trodden-down the-seed-of-Jacob, will-be-spared."

**72:5** "And-this-will-be-so, because-some-among-all-the-nations have-been-subject to-your-people."

**72:6** "But-all-those-who-have-ruled-over-you, or-have-known-you, will-be-given-up-to-the-sword."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
